LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 9.1.1 SELF- EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression, part of Strand 9 in Grade 4 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to engage appropriately in a conversation? 2. Why is it important to obey leaders?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe a real life experience using acquired language,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use appropriate turn taking and polite interruption skills in a conversation,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate discussing daily experiences using acquired language strategies.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. describe a real life experience using acquired language,

   Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. use appropriate turn taking and polite interruption skills in a conversation,

   Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate discussing daily experiences using acquired language strategies.

   Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. describe a real-life experience based on the theme using vocabulary acquired,

2. listen to an audio recording (with information on community leaders) on appropriate turn-taking and polite interruption skills,

3. work jointly to identify verbs from the audio recording,

4. practice using verbs in sentences appropriately,

5. conduct a panel discussion on the theme while taking into account appropriate turn taking and polite interruption. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. describe a real-life experience based on the theme using vocabulary acquired,
2. listen to an audio recording (with information on community leaders) on appropriate turn-taking and polite interruption skills,
3. work jointly to identify verbs from the audio recording,
4. practice using verbs in sentences appropriately,
5. conduct a panel discussion on the theme while taking into account appropriate turn taking and polite interruption. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Self- expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: This is enhanced as the learner follows simple instructions to use verbs appropriately

in sentence construction.

• Digital Literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to audio recordings on

appropriate turn taking and polite interruption skills.

Values:
Unity: This is enhanced as the learner appreciates the effort of others when conducting a panel discussion on the theme.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Good governance: This is promoted as the learner holds a panel discussion on the theme while ensuring appropriate turn taking

and polite interruption.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept on leadership to their learning of similar concepts in Social Studies.
